protocol.planned_windows: All starts range(0, frames-round(10*fps)+1, round(fps)); center=(start+window/2)/fps. Old/new grids must match exactly within 1e-8 s; no fitted offset.
protocol.output_definition: accepted Boolean AND finite prediction in the evaluated estimator column
protocol.reference_eligibility: Finite positive calculable reference HR; UBFC additionally requires time coverage. Raw physiological reference quality has NOT been independently audited.
protocol.C_out: 100 * Noutput / Nplanned (all planned windows, including no-reference cases)
protocol.C_ref: 100 * Nvalid / Nref; undefined without reference-eligible windows
protocol.R5: 100 * count(abs(prediction-reference)<=5) / Nref; zero if Nref>0 but no correct output, undefined if Nref=0
protocol.P10_R10: Analogous definitions at 10 bpm; boundary inclusive
protocol.LoA: Descriptive Bias +/-1.96 * sample SD(ddof=1); undefined at N<2. Not confidence intervals, not population limits established by independent subjects.
protocol.common_windows: All seven final-output intersections plus explicitly named pair intersections. Count Ncommon_ref is printed for every row; original C/R denominators are never replaced by the common subset.
protocol.delta_sign: after minus before; lower error is favorable, higher coverage/R5/SNR is favorable. Paired SNR median is median of per-window differences, not difference of medians.
protocol.delta_SNR_sign_counts: Positive/negative/tie proportions use +/-1e-9 dB numerical tolerance so machine-precision differences are not called gains. Raw >0 proportion is retained separately. This tolerance does not define meaningful biological improvement.
protocol.waveform_SNR: 10*log10(sum(PSD at reference H1 +/-0.1Hz)/sum(other PSD in 0.7-3.5Hz)); only H1 counted. Not an absolute calibrated artifact-energy measurement.
protocol.waveform_input: Saved base column; no extra filtering. fps=1/median(diff(saved time_s)); start=round(center*fps-n/2). Require accepted HR window plus complete finite waveform segment and calculable reference.
protocol.waveform_common: Four waveforms: V1 POS, V1 CHROM, V2 fusion, V2.1 fusion; own, all-four intersection and each-baseline/V2.1 paired SNR.
protocol.waveform_generation: Generation flags describe proposal-stage waveform construction, independent of final HR acceptance. A complete finite base window with no own generation is neighbor-covered; generation and finite coverage are not waveform quality.
protocol.waveform_r: Not computed: no independently validated synchronized waveform morphology ground truth. Narrow 0.7-3.5 Hz output cannot establish dicrotic-notch recovery.
protocol.branch_timing: V2.1 local peak uses offline preprocessed/fused base; its ridge is explicitly offline DP using future windows. Neither is called forward, online or real-time. The V2 forward label refers only to its proposal selection, not its waveform pipeline.
protocol.selection: No parameter fitting, reference-guided peak choice, temporal-offset fitting or accuracy scoring for unreferenced video.
protocol.comparison: Exactly seven HR branches: V1 POS/CHROM local and offline DP; V2 fusion forward proposal; V2.1 fusion local and offline DP. V2.1 POS/CHROM are audited as unchanged baseline controls, not added as scored branches.
protocol.final_HR_consistency: Every V2.1 final HR row is independently reproduced from saved base, observed and interpolated columns with the unchanged legacy estimator. Raw spectral peaks are first compared to raw_spectral_peak_bpm; rejected rows then have both final outputs masked to NaN before comparison. Waveform observed replaces trace.rgb_valid; no provenance mask is invented. The same saved base waveform is used for SNR.
protocol.independent_contributor_audit: Positive diagnostic waveform weights define ROI-by-sample activity; generated flags and actual ROI counts are independently reconstructed, then covered=ANY activity, observed=ALL active ROI observation, interpolated=ANY active ROI interpolation. This audit never calls new grouping or waveform/HR adapter modules.
protocol.baseline_equality: V2.1 POS/CHROM HR, accepted flags and statuses are compared to retained V1; waveform base compared at 1e-9 absolute numerical tolerance. Exact prediction equality is recorded separately.

pre_validation_protocol.selection: All five retained videos. These are previously inspected regression cases.
changes: Final local/offline DP HR estimated from actual saved fused waveform.
Sampling/interpolation provenance from actual positive-weight contributors.
pre_validation_protocol.unchanged: Frontend, POS/CHROM, filters, DP cost and numeric thresholds unchanged.
pre_validation_protocol.evaluation: Predictions precede reference evaluation; no new-dataset or generalization claim.

limitations: Only UBFC has a human device-HR reference, not ECG; reference computational eligibility is not an independent physiological-quality audit.
synthetic72 is known color modulation, not human accuracy; the other three videos have no synchronized reference and no accuracy/SNR score.
Overlapping windows are dependent. No statistical significance, population confidence interval or clinical validity is established.
V2.1 was motivated by post-hoc UBFC diagnosis. Reusing this video cannot establish independent generalization or an unbiased improvement estimate.
Reference H1 SNR is a band-power ratio; it does not establish absolute artifact power, waveform morphology or recovery of dicrotic notches.
Offline fusion can cover a window using neighboring contributions, and offline DP can use additional/future windows even when error is scored on a common subset.
